summary.text: Matt Post is a Democratic candidate for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 14, in the November 3, 2026 general election, and a lawyer who advanced from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is Assistant Counsel for the Maryland State Education Association and previously served on the Montgomery County school board.

paragraphs.text: Matt Post earned a high school diploma from Sherwood High School, a bachelor's degree from Yale College and a law degree from Yale Law School, according to Ballotpedia.
In the survey, he said the district has been his home his entire life.
He said that on the school board he championed career and technical education and expanded mental health resources, and that at March For Our Lives he worked on gun violence prevention laws.

Post said his priorities include lowering energy bills by requiring data centers to bring their own clean energy and pay for grid improvements, banning forecast test years for utilities, and cutting red tape for small businesses.
He listed endorsements from Congressman Jamie Raskin and former County Executive Ike Leggett.
